title: Discovery
text: We walk your space, listen to how you live or work, and agree on scope, budget range and timing before anything is drawn.

title: Concept
text: Moodboards, layout options and material palettes. You see two clear directions — never ten half-ideas.

title: Design development
text: Drawings, 3D views, joinery details and a fixed quotation. Every finish is chosen and priced before work starts.

title: Joinery & build
text: Our workshop fabricates your bespoke pieces while the site team prepares services, surfaces and fittings.

title: Install & handover
text: White-glove installation, snagging with you room by room, then a signed handover with warranty documents.
